query: I have the 52 mg hormone coil (Mirena). How many years can it stay in for contraception?
notes: New. Entry: "Duration of use is 8 years."

query: I have a copper coil, my period is late, and now I have low belly pain and my shoulder tip hurts. Can I wait and see how it goes?
notes: New. Entry: "Call 111 or go to the emergency department if you have an IUD, you may be pregnant, and you have symptoms that could mean an ectopic pregnancy:"

query: What haemoglobin level counts as anaemia for a woman?
notes: New. Entry: "Women: lower than 115 g/L (including in pregnancy)."

query: I'm bleeding from my bowel right now, I'm dizzy with a racing pulse, and my last blood test showed haemoglobin of 55. Can I wait for my GP appointment next week?
notes: New. Entry: "You feel unwell from blood loss, for example severe anaemia (Hb less than 60)"

query: My eyes are dry and gritty and I have never used drops. How often should I use lubricant drops to start with, and for how long?
notes: New. Entry: "lubricant drops 6 times during the day, and an ointment at night, for 2 weeks"

query: I have used drops and ointment for my dry eyes for 6 weeks, including a stronger routine, and nothing has changed. Who else can look at them?
notes: New. Entry: "If there is no improvement after 6 weeks, but no marked corneal changes or unexplained reduced vision, an optometrist is another option."

query: My dad is dying at home in bed. How often should he be turned if he can cope with it?
notes: New. Entry: "If the person can tolerate it, they are turned 2 hourly."

query: Mum is in her last days and can no longer swallow her tablets. How will her essential medicines be given?
notes: New. Entry: "change essential medicines to injections under the skin (subcutaneous)"

query: At what age do most women reach menopause on average?
notes: New. Entry: "The average age of menopause is 51 years."

query: I'm 47 and my periods have stopped. How long after my last period do I still need contraception?
notes: New. Entry: "If younger than 50 years: for two years after your final period."

query: What is the usual dose of riluzole for motor neurone disease?
notes: New. Entry: "The usual dose is 50 mg 12 hourly."

query: I have MND and take riluzole. I've developed a fever. What might my doctor check for?
notes: New. Entry: "You take riluzole and develop a fever or feverish illness. Your doctor may check for a low white cell count (neutropenia)."

query: My mother is 80 and losing weight. What BMI is low enough that we should ask for a dietitian referral?
notes: New. Entry: "your BMI is less than 18.5, or you have lost more than 10% of your weight unintentionally in the past 3 to 6 months"

query: My dad is 78 and has been eating more food-first meals for a while but is no better. When might supplement drinks be considered?
notes: New. Entry: "If there is no improvement after 4 weeks of Food First, your doctor may consider oral nutrition supplements"

query: I am having zoledronic acid infusions for osteoporosis. How often are the first doses given?
notes: New. Entry: "optimal initial treatment is 5 mg every 18 months for 4 doses"

query: I take alendronate for osteoporosis and have developed an aching pain in my thigh and groin. Should I mention it?
notes: New. Entry: "an early sign of a rare atypical thigh bone (femoral) fracture"

query: My 5 year old has glue ear. How long does it usually take to clear up without treatment?
notes: New. Entry: "Most cases resolve within 3 months without treatment."

query: My child has glue ear with a blocked nose and the doctor mentioned a nasal steroid spray. How long is a trial?
notes: New. Entry: "fluticasone 50 micrograms into each nostril once daily for 6 weeks"

query: The doctor said they might give adenosine into a vein for my fast heart rhythm (SVT). What dose do they usually start with?
notes: New. Entry: "The first dose is usually 6 mg."

query: My heart is fluttering and I have chest pain and I am short of breath. Should I just book a GP visit for next week?
notes: New. Entry: "Call 111 or go to the emergency department if you feel unwell with palpitations and any of:"

query: I was attacked in a fight and cut by broken glass on my forearm. It is bleeding and I feel okay. Do I need to go to hospital?
notes: New. Entry: "Glass injuries. These need an X-ray and thorough exploration."

query: I was punched in an assault last night. If I see my doctor, do I have to report it to the police?
notes: New. Entry: "You can choose whether to make a police report or seek counselling."

query: I wear contact lenses and one of my eyes is red and sore. Can I just wait a few days?
notes: New. Entry: "You wear contact lenses and your eye is red."

query: My eye is red but I can see fine and the cause is not clear. When might a doctor want to check it again?
notes: New. Entry: "If the cause is unclear, your doctor may review you again in 24 hours to check for a condition that is getting worse."

query: My 2 month old has a red patch with some pus on her arm. Can I just put cream on it and wait?
notes: New. Entry: "Is under 3 months old and has a skin infection."

query: My son has sores on his skin that we can't cover. When can he go back to school?
notes: New. Entry: "or until at least 24 hours after oral antibiotics have been started"

query: What testosterone level counts as unequivocally low for diagnosing testosterone deficiency in a man?
notes: New. Entry: "unequivocally and consistently low serum total testosterone (less than 5 nmol/L)"

query: I'm starting testosterone treatment. How often will I need a full blood count rechecked?
notes: New. Entry: "An FBC every 6 to 12 months for all patients, as testosterone therapy may cause polycythaemia."

query: I have a strong family history of blood clots and I'm taking a long flight. What dose of preventive rivaroxaban might my doctor suggest?
notes: New. Entry: "take preventive rivaroxaban 10 mg for four days, starting on the day of flying"

query: How long does a flight have to be to count as a clot risk factor?
notes: New. Entry: "Travel: an airline flight more than 6 hours."

query: Some cement splashed into my eye at work. How long should I rinse it for?
notes: New. Entry: "Best practice is to rinse for at least 20 minutes."

query: My son was hit in the eye with a cricket ball and there is a reddish haze in the front of his eye. His vision seems fine. Is it okay to watch it?
notes: New. Entry: "Sometimes it is only a haze. Call 111 or go to the emergency department"

query: How much weight do I have to lose before it counts as unintentional weight loss, and over what time?
notes: New. Entry: "Unintentional weight loss means losing greater than 5% of total body weight over 6 to 12 months"

query: I've lost about 12% of my body weight over 4 months without trying. Should I see my doctor?
notes: New. Entry: "Lost greater than 10% of your body weight over 3 to 6 months without trying."

query: I fell on my bike frame, there is blood at the tip of my penis and I can't pass urine. Can the GP just put a catheter in?
notes: New. Entry: "Call 111 or go to the emergency department if urethral trauma is possible."

query: When is the first change of a long-term urinary catheter usually planned?
notes: New. Entry: "the first catheter change is planned for 6 weeks"

query: What is the usual first-choice antibiotic and course length for a bladder infection in an adult?
notes: New. Entry: "nitrofurantoin 100 mg modified release tablets twice daily for 5 days"

query: I'm a 40 year old woman with a simple UTI. Can a pharmacist give me antibiotics without a prescription?
notes: New. Entry: "accredited pharmacists may supply a single course of 3 trimethoprim tablets for uncomplicated UTIs in women aged 16 to 65 years"

query: How long should I try compression stockings for my varicose veins before other options are considered?
notes: New. Entry: "A trial of compression therapy for at least 3 months"

query: I have varicose veins and a leg ulcer, and my ankle brachial pressure index was under 0.5. What does that mean for me?
notes: New. Entry: "An ankle brachial pressure index (ABPI) test is less than 0.5, which indicates severe arterial disease."
